Before a page enters search.

Inspect full sources. Resolve the local target, access and seasonal question. Check the gear system. Publish only the supported guide, then create its operator preparation link and a demonstration of the actual local decision. Search eligibility uses the separate species, season-section, local-description and canonical-URL checks. Access and equipment claims still need their own evidence.

Exact-product review, affiliate tracking, operator inventory and hosted analytics remain separate integrations; none is invented by this release.
